hlido_opinion.headline: Functional last-mile logistics AI agent — reliable but lacks standout features.
hlido_opinion.body: The last-mile logistics environment agent demonstrates a solid foundation for handling delivery operations. While it performs reliably, it does not exhibit any significant differentiators compared to its competitors. The functionality is adequate for basic logistics tasks, but users seeking advanced features or integrations may find it lacking. Its performance is stable, making it a reasonable choice for organizations needing straightforward logistics solutions. However, without unique selling points, it may struggle to capture the attention of users exploring more innovative options in the market.

tier_rationale: STEADY (57) because the agent functions reliably for basic logistics tasks, but it lacks standout features that would elevate it to a higher tier. It remains competitive but does not lead the category in innovation or user experience.
